initialisation.base: Independent Uniform(0,1) probabilities for root nodes; Factionalizing uses the Y conditional table .9/.1.
initialisation.target: q = first root-probability draw for the same agent and seed.
initialisation.formula: P(z) = q Q(z|G=1) for G(z)=1; otherwise (1-q) Q(z|G=0).
initialisation.interpretation: Q is the base Bayesian-network prior. P is the matched initial joint prior. Calibration preserves within-stratum distributions but generally introduces dependencies; base CPTs do not factorise P without initial conditioning on G calibration.
initialisation.trust: H prior q; initial source trust .90 in every environment.
